stereotypeDefinition.comment: Overrides how the guardrail contract declares this Integration Event, Integration Command or Eventing DTO property. Required adds the C# required modifier, as the code declares it.
stereotypeDefinition.name: Property Configuration
stereotypeDefinition.targetFilterFunction: // Property (on a Message or Integration Command), Eventing DTO-Field return ["bde29850-5fb9-4f47-9941-b9e182fd9bdc", "93eea5d7-a6a6-4fb8-9c87-d2e4c913fbe7"].indexOf(element.specializationId) >= 0;

property.hint: Tick when the code declares this property required (C# 11), e.g. public required string Name { get; init; }. On its first merge into an existing file, Merge replaces a property's modifiers with the generated ones, so an unmodelled required is dropped. Ignored on a positional record's fields, which are constructor parameters.
property.name: Required
